notes: «وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ» opens with a passive transmission; Maysir is the first link.
Maysir asks the Imam («قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»): the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2).

fixes.reason: RWY reads the passive verb روي as a transmitter name; in the text روي is the verb and the first link is Maysir.
